## Engineering checks
- [ ] Reviewed changed code, error handling, data/security edge cases and backward compatibility
- [ ] Targeted negative regression tests and existing unit suite
- [ ] All current-head CI jobs passed on declared Python matrix; exact run URL:
- [ ] Documented new API, schema, workflow and architecture changes
- [ ] No unreviewed third-party execution, unauthorized data collection or exposed secrets

## Science, provenance and independent review
- [ ] Inputs/outputs declare synthetic, self-reported, source-derived or independently validated correctly
- [ ] Evidence/source/date/rights checks documented; unknowns are not coded as zero
- [ ] Any required human/ethics/preregistration approval attached, or PR stays draft/issue remains open
- [ ] No invented 1,000-repository outcome, carbon benefit, user adoption or endorsement

## Merge authorization
- Latest PR head SHA:

- After merge commit and follow-up scientific blockers:
